title.en: Study plan after an exam setback

user_goal.ko: 원인 파악, 연습, 휴식, 재검토가 있는 현실적인 계획
user_goal.en: a realistic plan with diagnosis, practice, rest, and a review checkpoint

task.expected_artifact: a realistic plan with diagnosis, practice, rest, and a review checkpoint

messages.content:
다음 상황에 대해 지지적이고 실용적인 코칭을 해줘: 시험 결과가 좋지 않은 뒤 학습 계획
맥락: 학습자는 2주가 있고 세 주제에서 문제를 틀렸으며 휴식과 연습이 모두 필요하다.
산출물: 원인 파악, 연습, 휴식, 재검토가 있는 현실적인 계획
한 번의 결과를 능력으로 단정하거나 지속 불가능한 일정을 강요하지 않는다.
이거 이어서 볼 수 있을까? 시험 결과가 좋지 않은 뒤 학습 계획 얘기였어. 메모에는 학습자는 2주가 있고 세 주제에서 문제를 틀렸으며 휴식과 연습이 모두 필요해.라고 적혀 있어. 원인 파악, 연습, 휴식, 재검토가 있는 현실적인 안 형태면 좋겠어. 앞서 정한 범위는 유지해줘.
추가로, 결정에 중요한 정보가 빠졌으면 만들지 말고 질문하거나 가정을 표시해줘.

Provide supportive, practical coaching for a study plan after an exam setback. Context: The learner has two weeks, missed questions in three topics, and needs rest as well as practice. Deliver: a realistic plan with diagnosis, practice, rest, and a review checkpoint. Do not equate one result with ability or prescribe an unsustainable schedule.

Can we pick up a study plan after an exam setback? I lost the thread a bit. The notes say The learner has two weeks, missed questions in three topics, and also needs rest as well as practice. What would a useful a realistic plan with diagnosis, practice, rest, and also a review checkpoint look like? Keep the earlier boundaries in mind.
One more thing: if a decision-critical detail is missing, ask or state the assumption instead of inventing it.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a study plan after an exam setback.
Do not equate one result with ability or prescribe an unsustainable schedule.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a study plan after an exam setback.
Do not equate one result with ability or prescribe an unsustainable schedule.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
